notes.title: DEVLOG 3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi, everyone![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/0152fde68b5d50dedbe5e24d30a4c576e945b675.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update post. All this time we were diligently working on the game and we are excited to show you all this new content! At first, we’ve planned to release in Q2 of 2025, but it was too optimistic, and, in the end, we’ve decided to add more of the new content and move the release date to Q4 of 2025.[/p][h1] 
New characters[/h1][p]First of all, there are 3 new characters. And 2 of them will get spicy content.[/p][h1][b]Cara[/b][/h1][p][b]Cara[/b] – cheerful girl with shady past. What is hiding behind her happy-go-lucky exterior? Would you like to know her secrets? Will you be kind enough to help her after that? Her fate is in your hands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/22226bfef92ead9d405c7d84c9fc31f9b048aa21.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Mia[/b] [/h1][p][b]Mia[/b] – guild clerk lady that is so-o-o bored on her job that she flirts with adventurers for fun. Maybe you will be able to provide her some entertainment?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/2a5e3c0d0703a29d39006494d8934268bc8b7ca4.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Helene[/b][/h1][p][b]Helene[/b] – lady also known as legendary adventurer Grim Dawn. She is mischievous and powerful – perfect mix, right? Only thing she won’t joke about is [i]hunting[/i]. So, try your best not to become her prey, yeah?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/c58443ae1c74752621cf1e93253b6e25ba1681e8.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]New regions[/b][/h1][p]Next, there’s two whole new regions to explore: Forest Odah and Coral Bay. Each region has its own unique materials and recipes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/8011c5345248ca698900e511ef60d2f6c5b0f24b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/978ee8a0f67ec4cae72fe46b3337a0f311b85308.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]Here’s a sneak peek at new items:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/cdc3a7c51e8ffbc74e8ac625a2b72f9c63fe4812.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]And then there’s Dates.[/b][/h1][p]It’s a new mechanic that wasn’t shown in demo. You will be able to take Mirika out on dates.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/45e8fc90143e6011454c484418f6f226b100b2cb.png"][/img]On a date you can discuss various themes with Mirika, buy her food and learn what she likes best.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/c260f23abf4f606b52ec1a8b64dec73db06b6b03.png"][/img][/p][p]If the date went well, you will be rewarded with spicy scene. There are 4 special spicy scenes – for each dress that you can make Mirika wear before the date.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/8ff8897224405a9ca4835ca8e7d6f1ae532cfb6d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/9d52f54882401a44d0e047970614b6c101d8d378.png"][/img] [/p][h1]New clothes.[/h1][p]We’ve added new clothes that will work on the sprite and in the story. Also all the clothes are now divided by tabs - casual and for dates. We’ve limited available clothing options for dates, because it was taking too much time to realize.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/af0f3d18f67a66df928c4025ac39c89fefc9c84c.png"][/img][/p][h1]Main Story continuation.[/h1][p]Release version of the game will have prologue, three chapters and epilogue. New chapters are several times bigger than all the text available in demo and include branching.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/1db4c7f5cf520e2754f0314b71d6c4fdab07d1fb.png"][/img]There are also new side routes with side characters. Your decisions in these routes will influence main story and you will be able to open new 18+ scenes![/p][p]All the story and spicy scenes were updated – we’ve added new sounds and effects.[/p][h1]
More sex scenes![/h1][p]Right now, there are only 2 scenes available in the demo, we will add another 10 in release version of the game![/p]

Asset optimization.

Added Gallery for sex-scenes.
New music.
Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo v. 0.3 & DEVLOG 2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, everyone! [/b]

We’ve made quite the progress in the last month.  
 
Probably the most important decision was to remove the purification mini-game. We tried really hard to make it interesting and thought it would become fun challenge for the players. But, after multiple reworks, we still couldn’t make it work. The feedback we received on that mini-game was mostly negative, so we decided to cut it out entirely.

We decided to put the main focus on storyline and other in-game mechanics. We will try to make a good game with your support!

Now there's choices in the storyline and different endings as well. We saw that some didn't like possible NTR from succubus, so now you can reject her!

You can see full list of updates below.

[b]Future plans:[/b]

We plan to update DEMO several times, as game development progresses.

[b]What we plan to add:[/b]
⦁	SFX in story.
⦁	Dates & affection system will be available after the demo, so you would be able to try it.
⦁	Other languages (Chinese (Traditional & Simplified), Korean).
⦁	UI updates.
⦁	Demo sex-scenes gallery.
⦁	Journal and auto-play in story.
⦁	Update in-game music.

Here’s some sketches for future scenes. (¬‿¬ )

⦁	She needs some love
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/29b8d611d3406b10288d649ac54f9759cea38333.png[/img]


⦁	Feed her! (◕‿◕)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/2d1501f698b30fd16c046ec2092fa6fe63660d52.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/dc1fd77294d0ee2b8a0e75ca5b4550518c8f1ef7.png[/img]
 

That’s it for now! 
 
Thank you for your support! And if you have any feedback don’t hesitate to reach out to us! 
 


 
[b]Updates v. 0.3[/b]
1. Added choice before succubus sex-scene, now you can resist the temptation. (JP language will be added to this scene later).
2. Added emotions, reactions and voice acting(partly) to the interaction scene with Mirika.
3. Added SFX for sex-scenes. 
4. Updated Save\Load screen. 
5. Fixed bugs in inventory. 
6. Purification mini-game deleted. 
7. Improved controls for inventory. Also added instructions for said controls. Now the game will notify you with sound if you are doing something wrong.
8. Fixed blur and other graphic effects, now they are working properly. 
9. Text and translation improvements. 
10.  Added achievements. 
11.  Now you can add items for sale directly from “Trade” action. (You can access it by interacting with weapon rack in Main Room). 
12.  Added new tutorials and improved previous ones. 
13. Full rework of UI sounds.
14. Now scenes will load faster, due to asset optimization.
15. Now you need less gold to progress in Ch. 1.
16. Updated CG for sex-scenes (added breath, sounds, sweat, liquids, x-ray).
17. Updated Mirika CG before bedroom.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/29b8d611d3406b10288d649ac54f9759cea38333.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo v. 0.2 & DEVLOG 1
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone.

Sadly, we couldn't fix all the bugs before New Year's, so we released the demo as is. Now, after a bit of rest, we fixed all known bugs! Full list of bugfixes can be found below.

We will post devlogs at least once a month from now on.

[b]DEVLOG 1[/b]

Right now we are working on new scene - date with Mirika, where you can level up affection stat. In this scene you will be able to chat with Mirika and, depending on your choices, affection lvl will rise.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/0837d0f1f74fe20fc039836c0fc55deb8fc864f9.png[/img]

Also we plan further development of ore purification mini-game, so it can become more interesting and replayable. This mini-game took a lot of time to put together, so we want to make it fun! We will be sharing some development pics with you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/1365eca4d3af9ed04f434c11a49c39506779bd0a.png[/img]

Mirika interaction scene is also in further development. We want to add new dialogue and emotions. Affection lvl will determine how Mirika reacts to your actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179284/62204b7e9ac98199327375d7f65a0d3b78bccc87.png[/img]

That's it for now. Thank you for your support!

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Camera in purification mini-game now works normally.
[*] You can't use "Sell your crafts" in Prologue anymore.
[*] You can't open window for selling weapons in Prologue anymore.
[/olist]
